'''Bastian Winkelhaus Carbon Chamber Testing''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Bastian Winkelhaus]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds84.htm Carbon Chamber Testing], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010319180951/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds84.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
